What we do

Fences first. Then the rest of the house.

Most jobs start with the fence. Homeowners often add the shutters, garage doors or pergola while we're there.

  • Stain

    Fence staining

    Wood Defender stains in the colour or mix you pick, including our coffee and black blend.

  • Wash

    Pressure washing

    Grey, weathered wood washed clean before stain goes on.

  • Repair

    Fence repairs

    Loose boards and sagging gates fixed so the fence stands right.

  • Build

    Custom shutters

    Built, painted and installed in the homeowner's colour of choice.

  • Refinish

    Garage doors

    Cedar doors stained, or doors painted to match new shutters.

  • Accent

    Pergolas & sheds

    Pergolas, sheds and accent wood around windows stained or painted.
